reviews.text: We had a great experience working with Gotcha Covered! Laurie came out twice to discuss options and review fabric choices for our curtains and rolling shades. Price was very reasonable and better than 3 other vendors we got bids from. Laurie kept us in the loop throughout the entire process and checked in often even while we were just waiting for materials. We were able to get the interior window coverings done ahead of schedule. We also ordered rolling shades for our covered patio but due to ad

Highly recommend Gotcha Covered of Frisco! We used them for a custom curtain rod and blackout shades and we were so pleased with the quality and quickness. Greg also provided great customer service for the initial meeting and helped us pick exactly what worked best for us. Couldn't be happier with their services!

Highly Highly Recommend... Gotcha Covered team, there was one stop shop for upscale looks and great quality that came with life warranty!
We are just simply happy with roller shades in every room such as remote control roller shade in living room, black out roller shade in our master and hidden blind for the back door. Even it's all custom but they weren't take long to get the product ready to install. It's a right decision to go with all the options of color and materials. If you can go custom,

This is the second time we have worked with Gotcha Covered of Frisco for shutters. Both experiences were amazing. We love that we now have shutters throughout our house with our recent remodels. They take the time to measure on the front end, the installers are very professional, and they even came by afterwards to ensure we were satisfied. I can't say enough great things.

I had an amazing experience with Gotcha Covered. Matt from design had awesome recommendations and I am in love with how they turned out! Aaron was super efficient with the install and I cannot recommend this team enough!

This is the second time we’ve worked with Rick and team and once again, the experience was stellar. Matt was professional and efficient and helped us choose just the right fabric for our Roman shades. Robert did a fantastic job on installation and they followed up to make sure all was to our liking. We would highly recommend Gotcha Covered of Frisco!
Gotcha Covered was such a pleasure to work with! They love the details of what you want & they have the best staff! We are so very blessed by their work! Amazing! Amazing Job!

When our home was built almost 4 years ago, we had the good fortune to hire Gotcha Covered for our window treatments.  All these years later, one of our dogs decided to use a couple of the blinds for a snack…we called Gotcha Covered.  They still had all of our measurements, asked if the valences were still okay (so they would not have to bill for that) - they were. I had just purchased a home and needed window coverings for the entire home. I reached out to Gotcha Covered since they had a lot of positive reviews and were local. Matthew was my sales consultant, and he was very knowledgeable and willing to help. He had a very strong customer service approach and even came by my house a few times, so I could be sure to choose the right products for my home. Our curtains and roller shades are stunning. Matt & the Gotcha Covered team made the process so easy by coming to our house with samples and talking through our options. Whenever something wasn’t exactly perfect, they made sure that we were happy with how everything looked, followed up several times to check in & took trips over to our house whenever we had concerns. I highly recommend them and hope to use them throughout my whole house!

We recently had a fantastic experience with Gotcha Covered of Frisco. Rick went above and beyond helping us select our shutters and shades for each room. From ordering to installation, the process was quick and easy. Our house looks amazing and has an updated look. We love it! We highly recommend Gotcha Covered!

Gotcha Covered is hands down *the best*!  Have had the pleasure of working with Greg twice and he is simply outstanding!  Lots of choices for drapes and the installation was flawless.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
Great customer service!   I had not previously done  business with Gotcha Covered but when I called needing a relatively minor item they responded quickly.  Happy customer!

I want to thank Greg for all his hard work and honesty! They have great customer service and they did what they promised to do and even more! We purchased plantation shutters and zebra shades for our new house.  Everything looks great and the service we received from Matt and his team was outstanding!  I highly recommend these folks.
Rick and his team are very kind and responsible people, I like the work they have done.

This family company can be trusted all the way to deliver an excellent product and a friendly safe experience.  Matthew brought samples to the house, listened to our needs, and helped pick out the perfect product to fit our home and budget.  Installation team was quick and cleaned up carefully.  I will order more from Gotcha Covered!

My review of Gotcha Covered of Frisco is intended to help other homeowners in this forum.  I do not recommend this custom drapery company due to poor business practices, bad products and failure to deal amicably with people. Rick McGregor,  the owner,  lacks the skills necessary for elegant draperies. He should stick to horizontal blinds and do nothing else. There is not enough space here for a full account of events. Gotcha Covered had exactly what we were looking for in terms of product, price, and service.  We now have a beautiful shade across our large bay window in the kitchen, and blackout shades in the game room upstairs.  They also replaced a set of blinds in the side window to our front door with a perfectly-matched replacement.  I recommend them highly to anyone!

We had yet another fabulous experience with Matt Schaefer and Gotcha Covered!! Matt goes above and beyond to assist with window covering choices, getting the work ordered and delivered quickly.  The installation crews are always professional and on time.  I highly recommend Matt and Gotcha Covered!!
